notes.title: The trial version has been officially released for download
notes.notes:
Bahamut2-Come on,Fight! The trial version has been officially released for download. Players who are interested in this game can click "Download Trial Version" on the right side of the store page to try it out!
Bahamut2-Come on,Fight! The official version is expected to be officially launched on November 1st.

notes.title: The Japanese version is now available!
notes.notes:
Bahamut 2 - Bride of the Dragon is now available in Japanese!
If Japanese friends are interested, please download the DEMO and try it out. If you like it, buy it again!

notes.title: STEAM achievement update is online
notes.notes:
The STEAM achievement system is updated this time. There are a total of 25 achievements. If most of the achievement judgments have been completed, they should be automatically obtained as soon as they enter the game and read the record. A small number of them need to be played again for the final boss or master, and then Just hit it once.
If you have any questions, please report to me again, thank you for your support!

notes.title: Bahamut 2 now supports English language version
notes.notes: In order to allow foreign friends to play Bahamut 2 without barriers, this game uses Google Translate for machine translation and provides an English language game interface. Interested players can buy it!
